name: Apple and Peanut Butter
method: Slice the apple and dip into the peanut butter.

name: Avocado and Egg on Toast
method: Fry the eggs in the oil until the whites are set.
Mash the avocado onto the toast and top with the eggs.

name: Bacon and Broccoli Mac and Cheese
method: Boil the pasta, adding the broccoli for the last 3 minutes. Grill or fry the bacon until crisp and chop.
Whisk the cornflour into the cold milk, heat gently while stirring until thick, then melt in the cheese.
Combine the sauce, pasta, broccoli and bacon.

name: Bacon & Egg Breakfast Wrap
method: Grill 3 bacon medallions; scramble 2 eggs.
Warm a protein wrap, fill and roll.

name: Bacon Butty
method: Grill the bacon for 4–5 minutes each side until cooked through and crisp at the edges.
Butter the bread and layer in the bacon.

name: Banana Peanut Shake
method: Blend everything until smooth.

name: Banana Porridge
method: Simmer the oats in the milk for 4–5 minutes, stirring, until thick and creamy.
Top with sliced banana and a drizzle of honey.

name: BBQ Chicken and Sweetcorn Rice
method: Cook the rice. Fry the diced chicken, chopped pepper and onion in the oil for 8 minutes until the chicken is cooked through.
Stir in the barbecue sauce and sweetcorn, heat until bubbling and serve over the rice.

name: BBQ Chicken Wrap
method: Fry the sliced chicken in the oil for 6–8 minutes until cooked through, then toss in the barbecue sauce.
Pile into the wrap with shredded lettuce and cheese.

name: Bean and Cheese Quesadilla
method: Fill one wrap with the beans, chopped pepper, sweetcorn and cheese and top with the second wrap.
Toast in the oiled pan for 2 minutes each side and cut into wedges.

name: Bean and Vegetable Chilli
method: Soften the chopped onion and peppers in the oil for 6 minutes.
Add the paprika, cumin, purée, tomatoes, beans and chickpeas and simmer for 25 minutes.
Serve on the cooked rice topped with grated cheese.

name: Beans and Cheese on Toast
method: Warm the beans in a pan and toast the bread.
Pile the beans onto the toast and grate the cheese over the top.

name: Beef and Broccoli Noodles
method: Cook the noodles. Stir-fry the beef strips in half the oil on a very high heat for 2 minutes, then set aside.
Stir-fry the broccoli, carrot and garlic for 4 minutes, return the beef, add the soy and teriyaki sauces and toss through the noodles.

name: Beef Tacos
method: Brown the mince; add seasoning, garlic, purée, beans and a splash of water; simmer till saucy.
Load warm tortillas with iceberg, tomatoes, cheddar and a spoon of Greek yogurt.

name: Berry Overnight Oats
method: Stir the oats, yogurt and milk together in a jar.
Top with the frozen fruit and honey, cover and chill overnight. The fruit thaws into a sauce.

name: Boiled Eggs & Soldiers
method: Soft-boil 3 eggs (~6 min).
Butter 2 slices of toast, cut into soldiers, dip away.

name: Boiled Eggs
method: Boil for 8–9 minutes until the yolks are firm, then cool under cold water and peel.

name: Cheese and Bean Jacket Potato
method: Bake the potato at 200°C for about an hour, or microwave for 8–10 minutes then crisp in the oven.
Warm the beans, spoon over the split potato and top with grated cheese.

name: Cheese and Crackers
method: Slice the cheese and serve on the crackers.

name: Cheese and Spinach Omelette
method: Beat the eggs. Wilt the spinach in a hot, oiled non-stick pan, then pour in the eggs.
Cook until almost set, scatter over the grated cheese, fold and serve with toast.

name: Cheesy Tuna Pasta Bake
method: Boil the pasta until just tender and heat the oven to 200°C.
Soften the chopped onion in the oil, then stir in the passata, tuna, sweetcorn and pasta.
Tip into a dish, cover with grated cheese and bake for 20 minutes until bubbling and golden.

name: Chicken and Avocado Sandwich
method: Mash the avocado onto the bread.
Layer on the chicken and salad and close the sandwich.

name: Chicken and Bean Quesadillas
method: Fry the diced chicken and chopped pepper with the fajita seasoning for 8 minutes until the chicken is cooked through, then stir in the beans.
Fill two wraps with the mix and cheese, top with the others and toast in a dry pan for 2–3 minutes each side. Cut into wedges.

name: Chicken and Egg Fried Rice
method: Cook and cool the rice. Fry the diced chicken in the oil for 6 minutes until cooked through.
Push to one side, scramble the eggs, then add the rice, peas, soy sauce and spring onion and stir-fry until hot.

name: Chicken & Hummus Wrap
method: Spread red pepper houmous over a wrap.
Add chicken slices, iceberg and tomatoes; roll.

name: Chicken Burrito Bowl
method: Slice the chicken and fry in the oil with the fajita seasoning for 6–8 minutes until cooked through.
Serve over cooked rice with the beans, sweetcorn, chopped tomatoes and cheese.

name: Chicken Caesar Wrap
method: Stir the parmesan into the mayo for a quick dressing.
Fill the wrap with the chicken, salad and dressing and roll up.

name: Chicken Fajitas
method: Toss chicken strips in fajita seasoning; sear hot.
Add pepper and onion for 3–4 min; serve sizzling with warm tortillas and cheddar.

name: Chicken Fried Rice
method: Cook the diced chicken; scramble the eggs; set both aside.
Fry onion and pepper, then the cold rice and garlic; add soy.
Everything back in, stir through teriyaki, top with spring onion.

name: Chicken-Mayo Sandwich
method: Mix 80g roast chicken slices with light mayo.
Build the sandwich with salad.

name: Chicken Noodle Soup
method: Simmer the chicken in 500 ml hot stock for 12 minutes until cooked through, then shred it.
Add the sliced carrot and noodles and cook for 4 minutes. Finish with the spring onion and serve with bread.

name: Chicken Pesto Pasta Salad
method: Cook the pasta, drain and cool under cold water.
Fry the chicken in the oil for 6–8 minutes until cooked through, slice, and toss with the pasta, pesto, halved tomatoes and spinach.

name: Chicken Thigh Special Fried Rice
method: Cook and cool the rice. Fry the diced chicken in half the oil for 8 minutes until cooked through, with the grated carrot.
Push aside, scramble the eggs in the rest of the oil, then add the rice, peas and soy sauce and stir-fry until piping hot. Top with spring onion.

name: Chicken Tikka Curry
method: Fry the sliced onion in the oil for 5 minutes, add the diced chicken and cook until sealed.
Stir in the tikka paste, passata and coconut milk and simmer for 15 minutes until the chicken is cooked through.
Serve over the cooked rice.

name: Chickpea and Spinach Curry
method: Fry the sliced onion in the oil for 5 minutes, then stir in the tikka paste.
Add the drained chickpeas, passata and coconut milk and simmer for 12 minutes.
Stir through the spinach until wilted and serve over the cooked rice.

name: Chilli Con Carne
method: Brown the mince in the oil with the chopped onion and pepper until no pink remains.
Stir in the paprika, cumin, chilli flakes and purée, then the tomatoes and beans. Simmer for 20 minutes until thick.
Serve over the cooked rice.

name: Chinese 5-Spice Stir Fry
method: Fry the thighs with 5-spice till cooked.
Add stir-fry veg 3–4 min with a splash of soy; serve on rice.

name: Cod, Chips and Peas
method: Bake the chips following the pack instructions.
Brush the cod with the oil and bake alongside for 15–18 minutes until it flakes.
Boil the peas for 3 minutes and serve with a squeeze of lemon.

name: Cottage Cheese and Blueberries
method: Spoon the cottage cheese into a bowl and top with the blueberries.

name: Cottage Cheese Rice Cakes
method: Top the rice cakes with cottage cheese and sliced cucumber.

name: Creamy Chicken Pasta
method: Cook the chicken with garlic.
Stir in crème fraîche and a splash of pasta water; wilt the spinach in.
Toss with pasta, finish with parmesan.

name: Crispy Beef Noodle Stir-Fry
method: Cook the noodles. Fry the mince in the oil on a high heat, breaking it up, until browned and crisp at the edges.
Add the garlic and frozen veg, stir-fry for 4 minutes, then toss in the noodles with the soy and teriyaki sauces.

name: Egg Mayo Sandwich
method: Boil the eggs for 9 minutes, cool and peel, then mash with the mayo.
Sandwich with the salad leaves.

name: Full English Breakfast
method: Grill the sausages (15–20 minutes) and bacon (4–5 minutes each side) until cooked through.
Fry the mushrooms and tomatoes in half the oil, then the eggs in the rest. Warm the beans.
Serve everything with toast.

name: Greek Chicken Gyros
method: Marinate sliced thighs in oil, oregano, garlic, lemon; grill till charred.
Mix tzatziki: Greek yogurt, grated cucumber, garlic, lemon.
Build on warm pittas with iceberg and tomatoes.

name: Greek Salad Pitta
method: Toast the pittas and spread the inside with houmous.
Stuff with chopped cucumber and tomatoes and crumble the feta over.

name: Greek Yogurt and Honey
method: Spoon the yogurt into a bowl and drizzle with honey.

name: Halloumi and Veg Traybake
method: Heat the oven to 200°C. Toss the chunky-chopped courgette, peppers and onions in the oil and herbs and roast for 20 minutes.
Add the halloumi cubes and roast for 12–15 minutes until golden.
Serve over the cooked rice.

name: Halloumi and Veg Wrap
method: Fry the halloumi slices in a dry non-stick pan for 1–2 minutes each side until golden.
Spread the wrap with houmous, add the grated carrot, cucumber, spinach and halloumi, then roll.

name: Ham and Cheese Omelette Wrap
method: Cook the beaten eggs as a thin omelette in the oil.
Add the ham and cheese, then roll up inside the warm wrap.

name: Ham & Cheese Sandwich
method: Butter 2 slices; layer 60g ham, 30g cheddar and salad.

name: Ham and Cheese Toastie
method: Butter the outsides of the bread and fill with ham and grated cheese.
Toast in a pan for 2–3 minutes each side until golden and melted.

name: Honey & Soy Chicken
method: Fry the sliced chicken.
Add soy, honey, garlic and water; thicken with a cornflour slurry to a glossy glaze.
Steam broccoli, cook rice, pour every drop of sauce over.

name: Houmous and Carrot Sticks
method: Cut the carrots into sticks and serve with the houmous.

name: Lamb Kofta Pittas
method: Mix the lamb with the grated onion, garlic and cumin and shape into 8 koftas.
Grill or fry in the oil for 10–12 minutes, turning, until cooked through with no pink.
Warm the pittas and fill with koftas, shredded lettuce, cucumber, tomato and a spoon of yogurt.

name: Lasagne
method: Make the ragu: mince, veg, tomatoes, purée; simmer.
Cheese sauce from scratch: whisk cornflour into cold milk, heat till thick, melt in cheddar.
Layer, top with cheddar, bake 35–40 min at 200°C.

name: Lentil and Veg Soup
method: Soften the chopped onion and carrot in the oil for 5 minutes.
Add the lentils, passata, cumin and 500 ml stock and simmer for 20 minutes until the lentils collapse. Serve with bread.

name: One-Pot Chicken and Rice
method: Brown the chicken thighs in the oil in a lidded pan, then add the chopped onion, grated carrot and paprika.
Stir in the rice and 450 ml hot stock, cover and cook on a low heat for 20 minutes until the rice is tender and the chicken is cooked through.
Stir through the peas for the last 3 minutes.

name: Peanut Butter Banana Toast
method: Toast the bread.
Spread with peanut butter and top with sliced banana.

name: Peanut Butter Porridge
method: Cook the oats in the milk for 4–5 minutes until creamy.
Swirl through the peanut butter and top with sliced banana.

name: Peanut Butter Rice Cakes
method: Spread the rice cakes with peanut butter.

name: Peri Peri Chicken Thighs
method: Coat the thighs in peri-peri and oil; roast or air-fry ~22 min.
Microwave the buttered potato pouch; boil the corn cobs.

name: Pork Steaks, Roast Potatoes and Veg
method: Heat the oven to 220°C. Toss the chopped potatoes in half the oil and roast for 35–40 minutes.
Rub the pork steaks with the herbs and the remaining oil, fry for 5–6 minutes each side until cooked through, and rest for 3 minutes.
Boil the mixed veg for 4 minutes and serve everything together.

name: Prawn and Avocado Wrap
method: Mash the avocado with the mayo and spread over the wrap.
Add the prawns and salad leaves and roll up.

name: Prawn Salad
method: Prawns into a bowl with shredded iceberg, cucumber and halved baby plums.
Dress with Marie Rose sauce.

name: Prawn Teriyaki Noodles
method: Cook the noodles. Scramble the eggs in the oil, break up and set aside.
Stir-fry the veg for 4 minutes, add the prawns until hot, then the noodles, teriyaki and soy sauces and eggs.
Scatter over the chopped nuts.

name: Protein Grab-Bag
method: Zero prep: a Grenade bar, a protein yogurt pot and an apple.

name: Protein Pancakes
method: Blend the oats, banana, eggs and milk into a thick batter.
Cook spoonfuls in a lightly oiled pan for 2 minutes each side, then serve with the peanut butter.

name: Protein Smoothie
method: Blend a scoop of isolate, 1 banana, 200ml milk and a handful of frozen berries.

name: Salmon, Rice and Broccoli
method: Mix the soy sauce and honey, brush over the salmon and bake at 200°C for 12–15 minutes until it flakes.
Cook the rice and steam the broccoli, then serve together with the salmon.

name: Salt & Pepper Chicken
method: Toss diced chicken in seasoned cornflour; fry till crisp.
Stir-fry pepper, onion, chilli.
Egg-fried rice; combine everything.

name: Sausage and Mash
method: Grill or bake the sausages for 20–25 minutes, turning, until cooked through.
Boil the peeled potatoes for 15–20 minutes, then mash with the butter and milk.
Soften the sliced onion in the oil, add a splash of hot stock for a quick gravy, and serve with the peas.

name: Sausage and Potato Traybake
method: Heat the oven to 200°C. Toss the chopped potatoes, carrots and onions in the oil and herbs and roast for 15 minutes.
Add the sausages and courgette and roast for a further 25–30 minutes, turning once, until the sausages are cooked through.

name: Sausage, Egg and Beans
method: Grill the sausages for 15–20 minutes, turning, until cooked through with no pink inside.
Fry the eggs in the oil, warm the beans and serve with the toast.

name: Scrambled Eggs on Toast
method: Whisk 3 eggs with a splash of milk; scramble gently.
Toast 2 slices, butter, pile the eggs on.

name: Shakshuka with Feta
method: Soften the chopped onion and pepper in the oil, then stir in the paprika, cumin and tomatoes. Simmer for 12 minutes until thick.
Make wells in the sauce, crack in the eggs, cover and cook for 5–6 minutes until the whites are set.
Crumble over the feta and serve with toast.

name: Smoked Salmon Bagel
method: Split and toast the bagel.
Spread with soft cheese and top with the smoked salmon.

name: Smoked Salmon Scrambled Eggs
method: Melt the butter over a low heat, add the beaten eggs and stir gently until just set.
Fold in torn smoked salmon off the heat and serve on toast.

name: Spaghetti Bolognese
method: Brown the mince; soften the chopped veg.
Add tomatoes, purée and herbs; simmer 20 min.
Serve over spaghetti with parmesan.

name: Spicy Bean and Rice Bowl
method: Cook the rice. Fry the chopped pepper in the oil with the paprika and cumin.
Add the beans and sweetcorn and heat through. Spoon over the rice and top with cheese.

name: Steak and Chips
method: Bake the chips following the pack instructions.
Fry the steaks in the oil for 2–3 minutes each side for medium, adding the butter at the end, and rest for 3 minutes.
Fry the mushrooms in the pan juices, boil the peas and serve together.

name: Steak Fajitas
method: Sear the sliced sizzle steak fast; set aside.
Fry peppers and onion; return steak with seasoning.
Serve with warm tortillas.

name: Steak Night
method: Oven the crispy potato slices.
Sear the steaks 3–4 min a side; rest.
Steam the green veg medley.

name: Sweet Potato and Chickpea Curry with Naan
method: Soften the diced sweet potato in the oil for 5 minutes, stir in the tikka paste, then add the chickpeas, passata and coconut milk.
Simmer for 20 minutes until the sweet potato is tender, stir through the spinach, and serve with the warmed naans.

name: Sweet Potato Chilli Bake
method: Prick the sweet potatoes and bake at 200°C for 45 minutes.
Meanwhile soften the chopped onion and pepper in the oil, add the spices, tomatoes and beans and simmer for 20 minutes.
Split the potatoes, spoon over the chilli and top with cheese.

name: Teriyaki Chicken Noodles
method: Fry the sliced chicken.
Add stir-fry veg, then teriyaki sauce and cooked noodles; toss.

name: Tomato Soup and Cheese Toastie
method: Heat the soup until steaming hot.
Butter the bread, fill with grated cheese and toast in a pan until golden. Dunk away.

name: Tuna and Sweetcorn Jacket Potato
method: Prick the potato and bake at 200°C for about an hour (or microwave for 8–10 minutes, then crisp in the oven for 15).
Mix the tuna, sweetcorn and mayo and spoon over the split potato.

name: Tuna Mayo Pasta Salad
method: Cook 60g fusilli; cool.
Mix a drained tin of tuna with 1 tbsp light mayo.
Toss with pasta, 40g sweetcorn and salad.

name: Tuna Melt Toastie
method: Mix the tuna with the mayo and spread over one slice of bread, then top with grated cheese and the second slice.
Toast in a buttered pan for 2–3 minutes each side until golden and melted.

name: Tuna on Crackers
method: Mix the tuna with the mayo and pile onto the crackers.

name: Turkey Keema Curry
method: Brown the turkey mince in the oil with the chopped onion until no pink remains.
Stir in the curry powder and tikka paste, then the passata and 100 ml water. Simmer for 15 minutes, adding the peas for the last 3.
Serve over the cooked rice.

name: Turkey Meatballs and Spaghetti
method: Mix the turkey mince with the egg, half the grated onion and the herbs and roll into 12 meatballs.
Brown in the oil, then add the rest of the onion and the garlic. Pour in the passata and simmer for 15 minutes until the meatballs are cooked through.
Serve over the cooked spaghetti with parmesan.

name: Yogurt & Banana Bowl
method: Yogurt pot in a bowl, sliced banana on top, 15g chopped nuts to finish.

name: Yogurt, Berries & Granola
method: Empty a protein yogurt pot into a bowl.
Top with 100g blueberries and 30g protein granola.
